description: This file defines the IntegrationException class, which is a custom exception extending ServiceException, used within the integration modules of the sales manager core project to handle errors related to external system integrations.

classes.name: IntegrationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling integration-related errors, with error codes and error fields management.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with this exception.

methods.name: setErrorCode
methods.description: Sets the error code for this exception.

methods.name: IntegrationException (Constructor with Exception parameter)
methods.description: Creates an IntegrationException instance wrapping another exception.

methods.name: IntegrationException (Constructor with message and exception)
methods.description: Creates an IntegrationException with a message and underlying exception.

methods.name: IntegrationException (Constructor with code and message)
methods.description: Creates an IntegrationException with a specific error code and message.

methods.name: IntegrationException (Constructor with code)
methods.description: Creates an IntegrationException with a specific error code.

methods.name: IntegrationException (Constructor with message)
methods.description: Creates an IntegrationException with a message.

methods.name: setErrorFields
methods.description: Sets the list of error field names associated with this exception.

methods.name: getErrorFields
methods.description: Returns the list of error fields associated with this exception.
